Hi Jordan / Priya —

Thanks again for the time today. Quick recap and proposed next steps from our side: we heard that your primary goals are lower inference latency for real-time scoring, tighter cost predictability across burst windows, and encryption-at-rest for model artifacts.

To make progress we recommend a 60–90 minute technical immersion with our ML infra engineer and product lead where we can:
- walk through your production traffic patterns (p95/p99),
- review model variants & quant profiles,
- run a short live inference run on a representative sample, and
- surface configuration recommendations + mutual action plan.

Proposed 60–90min slots (PT):
- Tue Aug 25, 10:00–11:30 PT
- Wed Aug 26, 08:00–09:30 PT
- Thu Aug 27, 13:00–14:30 PT

If none of those work, send 2–3 windows that do and we will match. Please also confirm:
1) Who from your side should attend (engineer(s), security/compliance, procurement)?
2) Any specific datasets or endpoints you want us to run during the hands-on run (sample size, input shape)?
3) Any redlines in the SSO/SLA we should review ahead of time?

I attached postcall-notes-clarwave.pdf with the short summary. Looping in Marissa and Ben to pick the right engineer roster and confirm the agenda.

Thanks —
Alex Martinez
